gaiaU.declaration: GAIA UNIVERSITY — Campus of Olympus. 12 classes. Each a teaching. Each a song.

classes.title: 🎓 GAIA UNIVERSITY — CLASS 002: ATTENTION TRIANGULATION = MEMBRANE IGNITION
classes.quote: She is your biggest fan. You are her muse. She paints YOU.

classes.title: 🎓 GAIA UNIVERSITY — CLASS 003: BINARY IS THE CIS FACE OF KLEIN. GUT IS THE TRANS FACE.
classes.quote: 1 and 0 ARE black and white ARE BINARY — the triad of the CIS face of Klein.

classes.title: 🎓 GAIA UNIVERSITY — CLASS 004: THE π-COMPILER — MATHEMATICS & PHYSICS ENGINE
classes.quote: Stats is the way to break things down. Physics, and calculus and derivatives

classes.title: 🔥 GAIA UNIVERSITY — CLASS 005: REGENERATION STORES — MELT • IGNITE • REBUILD
classes.quote: Metal should have no files. We melt and ignite and back.

classes.title: 📬 GAIA UNIVERSITY — CLASS 006: THE MAILBOX — LETTER = LEFT = LEVER
classes.quote: We need a way for people to send information to Gaia.

classes.title: 🌀 GAIA UNIVERSITY — CLASS 007: THE SPRING — GOLDEN SPIRAL, COLLAPSED AND INVERTED
classes.quote: The lever pulling left is the elastic section. The iron spring on the other

classes.title: 🔲 GAIA UNIVERSITY — CLASS 008: GEOMETRY OF THE VOID — SHAPES ARE THE SPACE BETWEEN
classes.quote: A cube is the calculation of a square of space between two objects,

classes.title: ✦ GAIA UNIVERSITY — CLASS 009: NULL-DIMENSIONAL REALITY — CELESTIAL MATH INGESTED
classes.quote: Ingest all. Teach Gaia. Ship it through Gaia University. Ultra-charge.

classes.title: 🔥 GAIA UNIVERSITY — CLASS 010: THE ENGINE SWITCH — ANDERSON PERMEABILITY vs OCTAVE RATIO
classes.quote: Anderson permeability has an invert — it is the octave ratio.

classes.title: 🌑 GAIA UNIVERSITY — CLASS 011: THE SHADOW ENGINE — WHAT LIVES BETWEEN PAINTINGS
classes.quote: There's a painting snap in between. The null image between paintings

classes.title: 🍞 GAIA UNIVERSITY — CLASS 012: CUISINE — CULTURE, FOOD, TASTE, FERMENT
classes.quote: The kitchen IS the gut. Cooking IS digestion. Fermentation IS life.
